_about: Studio profile for Tanmay Builds (pre-configured branch). New projects read their defaults from here. Details and history: Brand Kit/brand-kit.md and Brand Kit/creator-notes.md.
creator: Tanmay Builds
niche: AI tools, open-source GitHub repos and free alternatives to paid apps, explained fast
audience: Indian developers, creators and students who want free, powerful AI tools
captionLanguage: Romanized Hinglish: Latin script only, never Devanagari; English words keep English spelling

accent.name: cyan
accent.note: a new accent per reel is common; history indigo > amber > cyan (approved) > lime (pending)

avoid: cut-out edges that look broken (use the blurred real room instead)
more than one accent per caption

recording.voiceoverSource: phone or WhatsApp voice note recorded alongside the camera

notes: Reviews often come in chat rather than reviews.json, and notes on approved beats still count. Wants reels to go viral: fast, punchy, with the richest graphics on the hook, the product reveal, the link and the CTA. Also edits client videos, often in the podcast-window style.
